short_title: Why do officials say 72 hours for your emergency kit? ⏱️ #shorts
short_description:
Why do officials ask every household to be ready for at least 72 hours? After a major disaster, rescuers can't reach everyone at once: they handle the most urgent emergencies first, and roads or power may be down. Water comes first: about one gallon per person, per day (Ready.gov). And 72 hours is only a minimum: Switzerland and Sweden suggest about a week.

Your body without water: https://youtu.be/hVkuWWfH_ug

Sources: Ready.gov (FEMA), American Red Cross, Get Prepared (Government of Canada), EU Preparedness Union Strategy (2025), Swiss Federal Office for National Economic Supply, Swedish Civil Contingencies Agency.
